statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because NQ is closed and no persistent one-way price path can be observed; Stress is extreme after flames and smoke were reported near Riyadh airport amid continuing Saudi, oil-supply and shipping disruption.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains EA_ON because Tail is below the WATCH threshold; weekend geopolitical and energy uncertainty is represented primarily in Stress until live NQ price discovery can confirm or reject persistent directional structure.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress as Riyadh airport incident deepens weekend geopolitical risk
body: NQ futures are closed, so current shallow-pullback, failed-retracement and repeated-extension behavior cannot be verified. Reuters reported flames and black smoke near Riyadh airport after aerial-threat alerts, while Saudi crude-routing disruption and constrained Hormuz traffic remain unresolved. Friday's Nasdaq gain was semiconductor-led but the session retained two-way structure. Shared Finviz context from 09:45:53Z is older than 90 minutes and was not used as current supporting evidence.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail peaked at 24% during Friday's event/whipsaw phase, then fell sharply as the session ended with two-way structure. Weekend Tail stayed low while Stress climbed back into the extreme band as Saudi security, oil-route and shipping uncertainty accumulated.
outlookSummary: The next 24 forecast hours remain before the Sunday NQ futures reopen. Saudi security, crude-routing and Hormuz headlines can change reopening-gap expectations and keep Stress extreme, but persistent no-retracement Tail cannot be confirmed while NQ is closed; future market reactions are treated conditionally.
